dialogues: TRINA: Oi barita……Osit Rakkhit….khub taka.. sob black.. knari knari taka barite rekhe dei.. ekbar bagane pnute rekhechilo bole..
JOJI: takar gach beriyechilo…

TRINA: na.. notegulo poche gechilo.. cellophin bag-e futo chilo…..tai jol dhuke…..shono… amai ora chene… amar sathe jabe.. tarpor dhuke emon babh korbe jeno jor kore dhore enecho.. taka niye jabar shomoy amar hatpa bedhe okhane rekhe chole gelei hobe….. beshi taka nebe na…. Bagan-e pnute rakhle ki hobe oder sob taka gona thake…….pore jodi jante pari…
SANJU: Na khali dosh lakh-i nobo…
JOJI: ar dhoro ektu adhtu commission….. ese to gelam.. jontorgulo bar kori……
TAXI-DRIVER: Babago……….
JOJI: eta ki holo….
SANJU: sorbonash hoye gelo….tor pistolgulo dekhte peyeche...ebar pulish dakbe… chaw palai….
TRINA: na….baba boleche kolkkata pulisher average reaction time chollish minit…. totokhone amader kaj hoye jabe…. Lets go.. quick….
TRINA: ar dos ghonta baki ache….ar dos lakh taka……garir modhdhe boshe thakle ghontai ek lakh kore taka hobe to?
SANJU: chaw…tarpor ja kopale thake….
data.memory: Joji, Trina, and Sanju are in a taxi planning a heist involving a wealthy man, Osit Rakkhit, who allegedly hides large sums of black money in his house and garden. Trina appears to be the leader, giving detailed instructions on how to stage the robbery and escape. The group discusses taking only ten lakh rupees and leaving quickly. However, their plan is disrupted when the taxi driver overhears their conversation, sees their toy pistols, and flees, threatening to call the police. Despite the setback, Trina remains confident, citing the police's average reaction time, and urges the group to proceed with the plan.

dialogues: TANIMA: Chobi-da amra ki ekkhuni bari chole jabo….???? Tumi arektukhon thako na amar sathe pleeeease…..
CHOBI-DA: Na mane….abar..boudi jodi boke.. mane.. thik ache…
TANIMA: Oooff.. ki bhiison bhalo lagche… sotti tumi na etto bhalo… oma.. chobi-da phucka khaoabe go… amar na bhiiiison phuchka khete ichche korche….
CHOBI-DA: Phuchka.. hna hna.. nischoy.. nischoy….ei phuchkaola… duto phuchka lagao dekhi….
PHUCHKAOLA: E phuchka bikkirir nei…..
TANIMA: She ki.. bikkirir nei ki.. eito koto ache…
PHUCHKAOLA: Bollam na.. bikkirir nei… mela jhamela korben na.. bari chole jan…
TANIMA: Oma.. dekhecho Chobhida.. ekta Phuchkaola amai sasachche….
CHOBI-DA: Ei.. beyadob…. Boro bar berocho na.. ek chore mukh chnire felbo.. bhoddoghorer meyer sathe kibhabe kota bolte hoy jano na……
CHOBI-DA: Mago.. mere felle…..mere felle…

TANIMA: Dekhecho.. ekebare joriye dhorle……oma.. buke hat dichche…bodmash.. gaye hat dichcho….tai roj bhulie bhulie cinemai niye jaoa……tai na?…othocho biyer kottha tullei aj na tanima.. kal na tanima…..ar neoachchi tomai cinemai…. Chotolok…
CHOBI-DA: Tanima… shono.. tanima….
memory: TANIMA and CHOBI-DA, a close pair, are seen at a phuchka stall. Their lighthearted banter turns tense when the phuchka seller refuses service and acts suspiciously. CHOBI-DA's fear and TANIMA's frustration lead to a humorous yet strained interaction. Meanwhile, the phuchka seller is revealed to be part of the commando operation, preparing for the kidnappers' arrival.
